newsitem.title: JORDAN: Jordan foreign assets rise 0.3 pct in September.
newsitem.headline: Jordan foreign assets rise 0.3 pct in September.

text.p: The Central Bank of Jordan's total foreign reserves rose 0.3 percent in September to 2,316 million dinars ($3,271 million) in August, the bank's monthly bulletin said.
(*) includes a 35 percent compulsory reserve requirement imposed on foreign currency deposits held by Jordanian banks. New regulations issued in late October cut the requirement to 14 percent.

The bank's figures do not provide a breakdown that shows the country's absolute net foreign currency cash reserves -- currently around two months imports levels and close to the IMF target of $620 million for 1996.
